description: This Swift source file defines a catalog of system sound effects and a player interface for playing sounds using AppKit and Foundation frameworks. It includes functionality for discovering sound files in system directories, mapping sound names to file URLs, and playing sounds either by name or from bookmarks.

methods.name: systemOptions
methods.description: Returns a list of discoverable system sound names with 'Glass' pinned at the top.

methods.name: displayName(for:)
methods.description: Returns the display name for a given raw sound name; currently returns the same string.

methods.name: url(for:)
methods.description: Retrieves the URL associated with a sound name from the discovered sound map.

methods.name: sound(named:)
methods.description: Returns an NSSound object for a given sound name, either by system name or URL.

methods.name: sound(from:)
methods.description: Creates an NSSound from a bookmark data, resolving security scope as needed.

methods.name: play(_:)
methods.description: Plays the provided NSSound object, stopping any currently playing sound.
